step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows 8 AWS service icons: CloudFormation at the top, Systems Manager (Parameter Store) at the bottom right, Kinesis on the left, S3 bucket below Kinesis, ECS in the center, EC2 Auto Scaling below ECS, EC2 Spot Instances (Fleet) at the bottom, and API Gateway on the right. Physical arrows connect Kinesis to S3, Kinesis to ECS, ECS to EC2 Auto Scaling, EC2 Auto Scaling to EC2 Spot Instances, and API Gateway to ECS. CloudFormation and Systems Manager are displayed without connection arrows.
